cells.gaps: The force gives the docket system as accessible at all Class A and B stations and about 90% of Class C stations (October 2026), with no count of stations and no share entering cases at the station when they are taken; how the record is made is not stated, and a 2026 essay says stations make the first record on paper (NAM-002, excluded source). The ministry's ownership is dated 2016, outside the 36-month window; no plan or finance has been found.
cells.note: The Acting Inspector-General says in October 2026 that the case docket system, in place since 2014, is accessible at nearly all stations, so it is past its pilot and live outside the capital. Stage 4 needs more than half of stations shown entering cases digitally at the station into the national system, and accessibility is not entry.
